title: Sufficient Conditions for Sharp Exponential Algebraic-Degree Growth
summary: Necessary conditions are known, but sufficient conditions ensuring sharp exponential algebraic-degree growth despite key-dependent coefficients remain open.

formal_statement.body: Find sufficient conditions guaranteeing sharp exponential algebraic-degree growth after $r$ rounds.

scope.domain: Algebraic-degree growth in symmetric cryptography with complex affine layers.
assumptions: Assignments to (f1, ..., f2r) satisfy the distinctness and inner conditions from Theorem 3.
parameters: (f1, ..., f2r) — valid assignments considered in the analysis
Concrete secret key — determines polynomial coefficients and may affect the maximum degree
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine sufficient conditions on the affine-layer parameters, valid assignments, and key-dependent coefficients that guarantee sharp exponential algebraic-degree growth after r rounds.

citations.label: Coefficient Grouping for Complex Affine Layers

progress.summary: The paper derives necessary conditions, but Remark 4 presents finding a sufficient condition as substantially harder. Secret-key-dependent polynomial coefficients may cause the maximum degree to vary across keys.
citation_labels: Fukang Liu et al., Coefficient Grouping for Complex Affine Layers
